title: AIs tools to help me make game(s) that have what i want
author: KingOctopus
selftext: I want to to make a game (games if i manage to learn from the first one) but i know nothing game dev, so is there a list of ai tools that should help me create games from the ground up, i'm not talking about an ai that make the game for me just aspects of it like, game design, level design,  character design, animation,etc... like little ai employees x)

comments.author: -RoopeSeta-
comments.body: Well.. AI sure can do those but you have to connect everything. And don’t be fooled.. it takes A LOT of time.

replies.author: KingOctopus
replies.body: I know, and i have a lot of time that's why i want to make the most of it

replies.author: -RoopeSeta-
replies.body:
Chatgpt for graphics, leveldesign, gamedesign (You need photoshop or gimp to modify images a bit)
Claude for coding
Suno for music
Animation you mostly have to do yourself. 
For videos you can use any AI that produces video.
Meshy ai for 3D objects

replies.author: KingOctopus
replies.body: OK sounds good, thanks, i'll try with that and some yt tutorials and see if i'm able to make something playable x)

comments.author: TheReservedList
comments.body: If you don't want to do game design, level design or character design, why do you want to make a game?

replies.author: KingOctopus
replies.body: i didn't i don't want to, i want help to do it, for ideas and prototyping things like that

comments.author: biblechat-andrew
comments.body: You can try [https://weebitgames.com](https://weebitgames.com) , a platform for game dev with just ai, no coding required. It's in beta though
